title: Build /health and /items REST endpoints
description: Implement an in-memory item store and HTTP endpoints GET /health, GET /items, and POST /items with JSON validation.
soloPrompt: Complete src/store.mjs and src/server.mjs so GET /health returns 200 {status:'ok'}, GET /items returns 200 {items:[...]}, POST /items validates {name} and returns 201 with the created item, and invalid JSON returns 400.
